name: Trirealm Rift Gorging Gorge
effectText: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) 6 cards from the top of your Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; banish this card (face-down), and if you do, Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters, except a Level 6 monster. You can only use this effect of "Trirealm Rift Gorging Gorge" once per turn. Other "Trirealm Rift" cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also your opponent cannot target them with card effects.
